subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Dinosaurs: different dinosaurs, how they lived and how we know about them today

show.line: Dinosaurs lived long, long ago. There are none left today. We learn about them from bones.

rounds.prompt: How do we know about dinosaurs today?
Some dinosaurs ate plants. Which dinosaur is eating plants?
rounds.praise: Yes! The long neck eats leaves.

rounds.prompt: Can we see a living dinosaur today? Say yes or no.

hints: Dinosaurs lived a very long time ago.
Bones in rocks tell us about dinosaurs.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I saw a dinosaur.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I saw a real dinosaur at the shop today!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Dinosaurs lived long ago. None are alive now.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Dinosaurs are gone. We only find their bones!

parent_line: Can say dinosaurs lived long ago and we know them from bones.
